# `pause_polar_align`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Stop the polar-alignment workers without restoring settings.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit and 32-bit builds, by command-socket invocation, which always writes shared diagnostics); the effect of the handler itself is probable |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcbc10 (64-bit build) |

Stops both the three-point and gyro alignment threads (the stop may block while the worker finishes) and does not restore settings. There is no state check; the stop result is not examined. The 3PPA event state keeps its last progress value after a pause.

Side effects: Stops the alignment worker threads; can block with no short timeout established.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

The inspected handler returns no handler-specific error code.

## Example

Request, call:

```json
{"id":91,"method":"pause_polar_align"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"pause_polar_align","result":0,"code":0,"id":91}
```
